signature.name: South Beach
signature.detail: Miami's most famous stretch of sand, known for its turquoise water, lively boardwalk and people-watching. Go early in the morning for a quieter beach and cooler sun, and bring your own towel and water since rentals add up.

signature.name: Art Deco Historic District
signature.detail: A compact stretch of pastel 1920s-30s buildings along Ocean Drive and Collins Avenue, best explored on foot. Late afternoon light is ideal for photos, and many buildings are best appreciated from the street.

signature.name: Wynwood Walls
signature.detail: An open-air gallery of large-scale street murals that changes regularly and anchors the Wynwood arts neighborhood. Visit on a weekday morning to avoid crowds, and wear comfortable shoes for walking the surrounding blocks.

signature.name: Little Havana
signature.detail: The heart of Miami's Cuban community, centered on Calle Ocho with cigar shops, cafes and street life. Go in the afternoon for the liveliest atmosphere and expect to pay in cash at smaller spots.

signature.name: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens
signature.detail: A grand waterfront estate with formal gardens and richly decorated interiors, one of Miami's most photogenic sights. Book tickets online in advance and go at opening time to beat the heat and crowds.

signature.name: Everglades National Park
signature.detail: A vast wetland wilderness just outside the city, home to alligators, wading birds and mangrove channels. Start early, bring insect repellent and sun protection, and check the park entrance and tour options before you go.

signature.name: Pérez Art Museum Miami
signature.detail: A waterfront modern and contemporary art museum with strong holdings of Latin American and Caribbean work. It is a good indoor option on hot or rainy days; check opening days and ticket prices online.

signature.name: Miami Beach
signature.detail: The barrier island that holds South Beach and much of the city's beach culture, with a long oceanfront promenade. Use the public beach access points and arrive before midday for parking and space.

stay: Good 3-4* hotel $180-300 a night; South Beach higher in season
transport: Metro and Metromover a few dollars a ride; rideshares and taxis add up
